info.title: Tranquil Sand Table API
info.description: REST API for controlling the Tranquil kinetic sand table device. For real-time updates, connect to the WebSocket API at `/ws` (see asyncapi.yaml).

tags.name: Playlists
tags.description: Playlist management. Every mutation is pushed to WebSocket clients and the cloud as a Playlists snapshot.

get.description: Returns the current playback state including pattern, playlist, progress, and settings.

patch.description: Partially update player settings. All fields are optional. Setting pattern_uuid or playlist_uuid starts new playback. Every field present is applied; if any of them fails, the response is that failure's status (400/404/500) with a text body of the form "<field>: <reason>".

post.description: Start playing a pattern, a playlist, or a random pattern. Provide pattern_uuid (single pattern), playlist_uuid (with optional shuffle/loop), or random (with optional loop).
Stop current playback. Use emergency_stop=true for immediate halt without deceleration.
Skip to the next pattern in the current playlist. Only works in playlist mode.

200.description: Skipped to next pattern, returns player state

post.summary: Go back to the previous pattern
post.description: Return to the previous pattern in the current playlist. Only works in playlist mode.

200.description: Moved to the previous pattern, returns player state

get.description: Get a paginated list of all downloaded patterns.

post.description: Upload a new pattern file (.thr format). The pattern will be converted to binary format and a thumbnail generated. Progress is broadcast via WebSocket.

get.description: Get metadata for a specific pattern.

delete.description: Delete a pattern and its associated files. If the pattern is currently playing, playback is stopped first. The updated pattern list is pushed to WebSocket clients and the cloud.

get.description: Download the binary pattern file. Only available for unencrypted patterns.
Get the PNG thumbnail preview of a pattern.
Get a paginated list of all playlists.
Get details for a specific playlist.

post.description: Add or remove patterns from a playlist.

patch.summary: Update playlist metadata and/or replace pattern list

post.description: Set the order of patterns in a playlist.

get.description: Get the JWT store token from the device's DRM license. Used for authenticating with the pattern store. Not reachable from browser pages: any request carrying an Origin header is refused with 403 (native apps send none).

403.description: No valid license, or the request carried an Origin header (browser cross-origin requests are refused; text/plain body in that case)

get.description: Returns basic device information including model, type, and firmware version.
Returns current system configuration including timezone, NTP server, and hostname settings.

post.description: Update system configuration settings. All fields are optional.

get.description: Returns the list of available timezones with their POSIX rules.
Static list of effect slugs for this firmware (cacheable; Cache-Control: max-age=3600).
Returns the LED system configuration including version and channel information.
Returns the current state of a specific LED channel.

post.description: Update the state of a specific LED channel. All fields are optional.

Starts the homing sequence on its own task and returns immediately (202). Poll GET /api/system/info (is_homing / is_homed) or watch the SystemInfo WebSocket push for completion. 409 when a run is already in progress.

409.description: A homing run is already in progress

500.description: Motion controller unavailable or the run could not be started

post.description: Clears NVS, patterns, playlists and license, then restarts ~300ms after responding. LAN only, and not reachable from browser pages: any request carrying an Origin header is refused with 403.

403.description: Request carried an Origin header (browser cross-origin requests are refused)

patch.description: Partial update. Absent fields are unchanged; presence (not a non-zero value) decides what is applied, so 0 is valid where it means something (motor_idle_timeout_s = 0 keeps the motors powered). Out-of-range values are rejected with 400. Motion values apply to the drivers/planner immediately; LED hardware changes rebuild the strip live (`led_applied`); steps_per_rev / microsteps set `reboot_required`.

put.description: Replaces the item list (max 32). `quiet_hours` is replaced only when present. Items with id 0 get one assigned; the saved schedule is returned. The change is pushed to WebSocket clients and the cloud.

400.description: Malformed items, or over the item / quiet-window caps

post.description: Stops playback and restarts the device after ~500 ms. Settings and the pattern library are kept. Not reachable from browser pages: any request carrying an Origin header is refused with 403.

403.description: Request carried an Origin header (browser cross-origin requests are refused)

post.description: Executes one action immediately (Run now / Test). Honours quiet hours unless `force` is true.

200.description: Result; success=false with a detail when blocked or the action could not start

mode.description: RANDOM_LOOP: a random library pattern follows each one until stopped

feed_rate.description: Playback speed, 1 (slowest) to 5 (fastest). Constant surface speed in table-radii per minute. Persisted across reboots.
Set playback speed, 1 (slowest) to 5 (fastest); values outside the range are clamped. Persisted across reboots.

random_loop.description: Random-loop mode. On: keep the current pattern and chain random patterns after it (or start one if idle). Off: let the current pattern finish, then stop. Playing a pattern or playlist by hand also turns it off.

random.description: Play a random library pattern now (pattern_uuid / playlist_uuid ignored). With loop, another random pattern follows each one (mode RANDOM_LOOP).

PlayRequest.description: Provide pattern_uuid, playlist_uuid, or random. If pattern_uuid and playlist_uuid are both provided, starts the playlist from that pattern.

download_url.description: URL to download pattern (empty if encrypted)

uuid.description: Optional client-chosen id; omitted = device assigns one. 400 when malformed or already in use.

num_leds.description: Number of LEDs in this channel

type.description: LED strip pixel format. RGBCCT = RGB + warm/cool white (e.g. FW1906).

state.description: Live effect state of the channel

has_leds.description: A strip channel is currently active

hardware.description: Configured (NVS) strip hardware, present even when the strip is disabled

w.description: Warm white level (RGBCCT channels only; omitted otherwise)

cw.description: Cool white level (RGBCCT channels only; omitted otherwise)

LEDChannelUpdate.description: Partial update: only the fields present are applied. Every change is pushed to all WebSocket clients (and the cloud) as an LEDConfig snapshot.

is_homing.description: A homing/calibration run is in progress

wifi_rssi.description: Wi-Fi RSSI in dBm (0 when not associated)

quiet_hours_active.description: A quiet-hours window is active right now

timezone.description: IANA zone the schedule is evaluated in

started.description: True when the homing run was started (it completes asynchronously)

rho_max_rpm.description: Default path speed (units/min) new patterns start at

stallguard_threshold.description: Sensorless-homing StallGuard threshold; applied to the driver immediately

accel_steps_s2.description: Per-motor step acceleration (steps/s^2). Applied live to the next segment.

junction_dv_steps_s.description: Max per-axis step-rate jump at a segment junction (steps/s). Applied live.

theta_max_rot_per_min.description: Theta spin-rate safety cap (rotations/min). Applied live.

motor_idle_timeout_s.description: De-energize the motors after this many idle seconds; 0 = never. Applied live.

MotionConfig.description: Runtime motion config (NVS-backed). Currents, StallGuard and the shaping knobs apply live; steps_per_rev / microsteps take effect after a reboot + re-home (the calibration is expressed in those steps).

LEDHardwareConfig.description: Runtime LED strip config (NVS-backed). Changes apply immediately: the strip is torn down and rebuilt with the new count/IC/format/order (no reboot). Prefer the string names for ic_type/format/color_order; the numeric `format` codes are the firmware's own (3=rgb, 4=rgbw, 5=rgbcct), NOT the protobuf LEDFormat enum. Also settable over the device console via `led_config`.

led_count.description: Number of pixels on the strip (1-2000).

is_rgbw.description: Legacy convenience flag; true iff format is rgbw. Prefer `format`. On PATCH, an explicit `format` overrides this.

ic_type.description: LED controller IC family. FW1906 is a 5-channel (RGB + dual white) IC. Accepts the raw int code (0/1/2) on PATCH.

format.description: Color channels per pixel: rgb=3, rgbw=4 (single white), rgbcct=5 (warm+cool white). Accepts the raw int code (3/4/5) on PATCH.

color_order.description: Wire order of the R/G/B bytes. Accepts the raw int code (0-5) on PATCH.

white_swap.description: RGBCCT only: swap the warm/cool white bytes on the wire.

led_applied.description: PATCH / preset responses: the LED strip was rebuilt live

reboot_required.description: PATCH / preset responses: steps_per_rev or microsteps changed; reboot + re-home to take effect

DeviceConfigPatch.description: Partial update. Absent or zero-valued fields are left unchanged.

id.description: Stable id. Send 0 (or omit) to have the device assign one; keep it on edits.

days_of_week.description: Bitmask, bit 0 = Sunday .. bit 6 = Saturday (0x7F = all days)

time_of_day.description: Seconds since local midnight (0-86399), in the device's timezone

obey_quiet_hours.description: Skip this item while a quiet-hours window is active

action_type.description: Legacy flat form, accepted on PUT when `action` is absent

quiet_now.description: A quiet-hours window is active right now

UpdatePlaylistRequest.description: Partial update. pattern_uuids, when present, replaces the entire ordered list (an empty array clears it). An empty name is ignored; an empty featured_pattern clears the featured pattern.

ScheduleLedState.description: Partial LED patch applied to every channel by action type 6 (set_led_state). Absent fields are left unchanged.

color.description: Hex RGB (#rrggbb) or RGBW (#rrggbbww); an {r,g,b,w,cw} object is also accepted

day_mask.description: Bitmask of the days the window STARTS on, bit 0 = Sunday .. bit 6 = Saturday

end_min.description: Minutes since local midnight; an end before the start wraps past midnight

pause_playback.description: Pause whatever is playing (single pattern, playlist or random loop) when a window starts and resume it when the window ends. A play, pause or stop issued during the window takes precedence. Accepted as the legacy key stop_playback on PUT.

lights_off.description: Turn the LEDs off when a window starts; channels turned off this way are restored when it ends

force.description: Run even while quiet hours are active

detail.description: Why it did not run (e.g. "Quiet hours active"); empty on success
